test_real_cloudfront: test the real CloudFront integration by writing reading and deleting files via StorageClient with signed URLs
test_CloudFrontSigner_sign_url: test the CloudFrontSigner class to sign a URL with an expiration timestamp and RSA private key
test_StorageClient_exists: test the StorageClient exists method to check if a file or directory is present in S3 or local storage
test_StorageClient_delete_dataset_direct: test the StorageClient delete_dataset_directory method to recursively remove a dataset directory from S3 storage
test_URLPreparator_prepare_url: test the URLPreparator prepare_url method to replace revision placeholders and sign asset URLs with CloudFront
